content: Now were hunted … Blake Campbell has disappeared along with his crew and his ship, he has been marked a criminal and deserter from the union of planets and by his own planet of earth, his daughter is now captive and slave to the sociopath Vengeance and Xera has become a casualty of this ancient feud .   The crew of the revenant find themselves  in the shadows, dealing with the scum of the universe along the way they meet  P herious, an alien  changeling ,  a creature that can alter his appearance at will ,  he aids the crew and despite suspicious motives aids Blake in his search for his daughter as the crew  tries to avoid rangers and bounty hunters aiming to bring the AWOL renegades to justice.  AD BLURB The anticipated follow up to  Vengeance ,  Blake and his team are now hunted as traitors and deserters, he has given up everything to find his daughter and to get revenge for Xera his friend and crew mate.  Daughter = Gracie
